image_description: A person wearing a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) over a black padded gambeson. The armor features embossed decorative lines, leather straps for attachment at the shoulders and waist, and a fauld (waist armor) extending below the main plate. The surface is highly reflective, showing environmental reflections.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types.
To verify the physical continuity of the metal plate and ensure no 'melting' into the underlying gambeson or skin.
To assess the 3D curvature of the armor and ensure the reflections align with the geometric shape.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the metal reflection or the fabric of the gambeson.

focus_areas: Reflection consistency on curved metal surface
Boundary sharpness between metal plate and leather straps
Texture differentiation between steel and fabric
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the breastplate. In AI images, reflections often fail to match the curvature of the object or contain distorted/inconsistent scenery. Verify if the embossed lines follow the 3D contour of the chest correctly without warping unnaturally.
